title: Volume of a Torus Using Pappus's Theorem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the Theorem of Pappus to find the volume of a torus generated by revolving a circular disk of radius r centered at (R, 0) about the y-axis (where R > r).

steps.title: Find Area of the Circular Disk
Determine Distance Traveled by Centroid
steps.explanation: The center of the circle travels a circular path of radius R.

steps.title: Compute Volume
steps.mathExpression: V = 2\pi \bar{x} A = 2\pi R (\pi r^2) = 2\pi^2 R r^2
steps.explanation: Multiply path length by disk area.
